about: The home page sells the season guests are booking, about 60 days ahead. Dates are month-day. To turn a moment off, change its "active" to false.

winter.headline: Hot tub’s on. Fire’s lit.
winter.subhead: A Blue Ridge farmhouse for six: steam rising off the hot tub, wine by the fire, and Wintergreen’s slopes {wintergreen} minutes away.

heroAlt.winter-hottub-steam: Steam rising off the hot tub at sunrise, the Blue Ridge behind.
heroAlt.winter-fire-bluehour: The fire pit lit at blue hour, chairs around it and the ridge going dark.
heroAlt.aerialDusk: The farmhouse at dusk from above, windows lit, the Blue Ridge behind.

spring.headline: The patios are open. So is the porch.
spring.subhead: A Blue Ridge farmhouse for six, minutes from Route 151’s wineries as their patios reopen.

heroAlt.porchView: The view from the covered porch across the patio and lawn to the Blue Ridge.

summer.headline: Pool’s open. Fire’s lit.
summer.subhead: A Blue Ridge farmhouse for six with a private saltwater pool, a hot tub and the fire pit at sunset.

heroAlt.poolLevel: The saltwater pool at water level with the lawn, the black fence and the Blue Ridge beyond.

fall.headline: The leaves are turning. Fire’s lit.
fall.subhead: A Blue Ridge farmhouse for six: fall color on the ridge, a hot tub and UVA game days 35 minutes away.

heroAlt.houseDusk: The front of the farmhouse at dusk, every window lit under a pink and violet sky.

moments.line: Christmas week is still open. A fire, a hot tub and nowhere to be.
Galentine’s weekend, sorted: wine, the hot tub and nobody in charge.
